items.title: Showreel '26
items.summary: Sixty seconds of the sharpest cuts from six years of work — brand films, montages, and motion packs stitched into one breathless run.
items.description: A self-directed annual reel: edit, grade, sound design, and animated typography all built in-house.

items.title: Neon Alley — Music Video
items.summary: Full post pipeline for an indie hip-hop release: 4K multicam edit, beat-mapped cuts, custom lyric typography, and a teal-sodium night grade.
items.description: Edited from 6 hours of multicam footage; every cut lands on the grid, lyric type animated per-word in After Effects.

items.title: Kinetic Launch Pack
items.summary: A D2C brand's full launch kit — 1 hero film, 12 vertical cutdowns, and a reusable motion-graphics toolkit with animated logo stings and lower thirds.
items.description: Designed a template-driven motion system so the brand team could ship consistent edits after handoff.

items.title: Creator Engine
items.summary: Ongoing post partner for two YouTube channels (400K+ combined subs) — retention-focused edits, thumbnails direction, and a house motion style.
items.description: Built each channel's visual identity: pacing rules, SFX library, colour language, and title systems that survive weekly upload schedules.
